title: tote plugin manifest, API 1
description: Structure of plugin.toml as parsed from TOML into JSON, for plugin API 1 as read by tote 1.0. Length limits given in bytes by tote are checked here in characters. Rules that need several values at once or the machine (coverage of exec: and env: permissions by the commands, placeholder scopes, anchored patterns, defaults that fit their field, duplicate ids, the 64 contributions in all, the base name of the running binary) are checked by tote plugin check and are not expressible here. Patterns are ECMA-262 in unicode mode (they use \p{...} classes). The lists of reserved ids, shells and blocked environment names are copied from internal/plugin/reserved.go.

id.description: The plugin id: never empty (an empty id is id_invalid).

version.description: Strict Semantic Version, no v prefix, never empty (an empty version is version_invalid). Equals the release tag.

tote.description: Range of tote versions: comparators >= > <= < = joined by commas, partial versions completed with zeros. No ||, ^ or ~.

tier.description: declarative is the only tier tote 1.0 supports. exec is reserved for a later version: the value is kept in the enumeration so that the structure of an exec plugin can be described, but tote 1.0 refuses a manifest with tier = "exec" (reserved_not_available, which makes the plugin incompatible) and never reads its [exec] table, so validating against this schema does not make such a plugin installable.

title.description: Display text. Menus show the id first.

requires_features.description: Names of host features the plugin needs. The pattern is the grammar of a feature name, not the list of the names that exist: a later tote announces more names, and a manifest that needs one must stay valid for this schema. The examples are the six that tote 1.0 announces. Any other name makes the plugin incompatible with tote 1.0 (feature_missing), the exec features exec.list and exec.run included: they come back with the exec tier.

i18n.description: Translations: only en and fr. A locales/<lang>.toml file wins.

template.description: Text with {name} and {name?} placeholders. {{ and }} are literal braces. Names: a field id, setting.<id>, repo.path|name|remote|slug|branch, cwd, home. Whether a field or setting id exists is not checked by this schema.

templateItem.description: A template of a [[list.action]], where item.id and item.data.<key> also exist.

plain.description: No control character, no line or paragraph separator and no format character except the two joiners: what tote accepts as plain text.

pluginId.description: Names the install directory, the settings file, the lock record and the TOTE_PLUGIN_<ID>_ variables. Verbs, reserved words, record field names and ids that start with tote- are refused. The official ids (gft, ghrel, ghsec, konsolai, ssh-tools) pass this schema: tote lets only the copy it ships and the official release of each id (totecli/<id>) use them.

permission.description: Closed vocabulary: exec:<program>, net:<host>, fs:read:<zone>, fs:write:<zone>, env:<NAME>, host:read:repos, host:open-url. exec:tote and the base name of the running binary are refused too, which a schema cannot know. The reserved entries (host:read:connections, host:handoff, host:clipboard, host:notify, host:editor) and the refused ones (hook:intercept, host:write:settings) are errors.

bin.description: Program name, looked up on PATH, never run by check.

hint.description: Text shown when the program is missing, never run.

optional.description: A missing optional program is a warning.

packagePath.description: Relative path inside the package, at most 6 segments.

execTable.description: Exec tier only. Reserved: tote 1.0 reads and checks this table and never starts the program.

platformBuild.description: Exec tier only. One compiled program per operating system and architecture.

pattern.description: RE2 expression, tried with MatchString: it must start with ^ and end with $, which a schema cannot check.

env.description: Variable names to templates. Each name needs an env:<NAME> permission. Loader and interpreter variables are refused.

prefixItems.description: The program: a literal word, never a placeholder, never a shell or launcher, never tote. It also needs an exec:<program> permission, which a schema cannot check.

env.description: Variable names to templates. Each name needs an env:<NAME> permission. Loader and interpreter variables are refused.

prefixItems.description: The program: a literal word, never a placeholder, never a shell or launcher, never tote. It also needs an exec:<program> permission, which a schema cannot check.

env.description: Variable names to templates. Each name needs an env:<NAME> permission. Loader and interpreter variables are refused.
Variable names to templates. Each name needs an env:<NAME> permission. Loader and interpreter variables are refused.

prefixItems.description: The program: a literal word, never a placeholder, never a shell or launcher, never tote. It also needs an exec:<program> permission, which a schema cannot check.

list.description: Exec tier only. Reserved: tote 1.0 reads and checks this table, shows no screen for it and runs nothing for it.

column.description: At least one column, and each column needs a non-empty id and label: column = [] and an empty entry are refused by tote (value_invalid, key_missing).
